decisions.decision: Build the whole course now; don't wait on T-232 or T-116. Day 3 runs today at 11:00 ET, and nothing has left Zoom yet because the Drive backup isn't connected. Write a source adapter. It reads the Drive copy ('Tantra Workshop Recordings/<week>/Day N') when one exists. Otherwise it downloads through the Tantra Centre S2S app (GET /meetings/{uuid}/recordings, using a fresh download_url, not share_url). Use it to pull Days 1 to 3 of meeting 87002851906 to local disk. Cut each day into lessons with ffmpeg, placing cuts at topic changes in the Zoom/Drive transcript (VTT). Give each lesson its own VTT slice and a text transcript. Store lessons in R2 and publish a buyer-gated course home in the centre at /pro/course. The course name is one config value (placeholder 'Tantra Pro'); T-116 swaps it later. Log the URL and the lesson list here, then move to review with Amal as reviewer.
decisions.why: T-232's backup isn't connected, so the Zoom files still exist (they're only deleted after a verified backup). The first cohort ends today. The course name (T-116) is one config value. Rule build-fully-a[redacted] says build now. Cutting and publishing is automation work, which is Claude's (owner-launch-constraints #5).
